nodes.text:
You're the one Sera's been sending out, then.

I dig the drainage. Nobody writes that down either.

Tired. Not frightened - we did frightened about four years ago and it turns out you cannot keep it up.

Now it is just Tuesday, and on Tuesday the ditch needs digging.

Osric swears the water went out further than usual last month. Says he could see the old road.

I told him the old road is a story his father told him. He told me his father dug this ditch. So now we are not speaking.

Sera keeps the ledger. Four years of ditch and not a line of it in there.

My mother would have called that a trust unclean. She had a phrase for everything and about four of them were kind.

choices.label: She sounds like a piece of work.
